note: EDeviceKeyBytes → BLEIdent (HKDF-SHA256, info "BLEIdent", L=16) · NANService (L=16, uppercase base16) · NANPassphrase (L=32, base64url without padding): the three derivations pinned to fixed values. The reference an Android implementation checks itself against. Swapping the three info labels or the three lengths is the failure this axis catches
